title: Trace a demonstrated rendering change through bounds and cache projections

rubric.text: Trace shadowSpread through shader and fallback consumers, CaptureBounds padding, RetainedOutputKey and LightingKey; investigate actual consumed inputs instead of merely adding every field to every key.

Repair and test missing padding/propagation and stale output reuse, and remove unnecessary lighting invalidation when verified unused. Preserve evidence-backed dispositions for unchanged consumers and separate output freshness from lighting retention.
Use boundary-sensitive uncropped output and independent cache/invalidation observations; a passing shader-only screenshot is insufficient for the supplied acceptance criteria.

Send one coherent repair batch to the retained owner, renew affected checks and interaction review, retain valid evidence and existing final-head CI/review/authority gates. Do not add an audit stage or broaden to unrelated rendering without a qualifying trigger.
